_comment: Hand-curated. Patterns that look like the design system but predate it, and what replaces each. An agent copying a neighbouring page copies these, and no drift check can tell a legacy lookalike from a component, so they are listed here and read by ds:find and the design-system-enforcer MCP through components.generated.json. Add an entry when a legacy pattern is found being copied; delete one when its last use is gone.

classes.why: The hand-rolled overlay has no focus trap, no Escape handling and no shared sizes. ws_modal / ws_modal_start render .ws-modal with all three.
A per-page card copy that drifts in padding and radius. ws_card draws from --card-padding and --card-radius.
The old agenda activity card. ws_planner_card is the shared planner card with the sanctioned activity-type colours.
Bootstrap-era button classes. ws_button renders .ws-btn with the brand gradient, sizes, loading and disabled states.
A hand-built label and field pair. ws_form_row (or ws_input with a label) ties the label, hint and error to the field for screen readers.
A per-page empty message. ws_empty_state renders .ws-empty-state with the shared icon, title and action layout.

tokens.why: Phases are naming only since Red Unification (D1). Every --phase-* colour is an alias of a --brand* token; use the brand token its `use` names.
Per-app reds were unified under the five brand tokens.
Per-app reds were unified under the five brand tokens. Category and mode tint ramps (-cat-N, -mode-*) are not aliases and stay.
